Name: Perceptive
Description: If the unit initiates combat, grants Avo+15 during combat. Avo increases with high Spd. [+1 Avoid for every 4 Speed.]

Name: Perceptive+
Description: If the unit initiates combat, grants Avo+30 during combat. Avo increases with high Spd. [+1 Avoid for every 4 Speed.]

Name: Break Defenses
Description: If unit’s attack breaks foe, unit makes an extra attack at 50% damage.

Name: Unyielding
Description: At start of player phase, if HP is 20% or less, restores 20% of unit’s max HP.

Name: Unyielding+
Description: At start of player phase, if HP is 30% or less, restores 30% of unit’s max HP.

Name: Unyielding++
Description: At start of player phase, if HP is 40% or less, restores 40% of unit’s max HP.

Name: Divine Speed
Description: Unit performs an extra attack at 50% damage in combat. [Covert] If extra attack hits, poisons foe. [Dragon] Unit recovers HP equal to damage dealt by extra attack.

Name: Lodestar Rush
Description: Use to launch 7 consecutive sword attacks at 30% damage. Adjacent foe only. [Dragon] +2 attacks. [Backup] +1 attack. [Mystical] Damage based on Mag.

Name: Canter
Description: Unit can move 2 spaces after acting.

Name: Canter+
Description: Unit can move 3 spaces after acting.

Name: Momentum
Description: Grants Atk+1 to first attack during combat for each space unit moved before attacking. (Max +10)

Name: Momentum+
Description: Grants Atk+1 to first attack during combat for each space unit moved before attacking.

Name: Headlong Rush
Description: Grants immunity to freeze.

Name: Gallop
Description: Grants Mov+5. [Dragon] Grants another Mov+1. [Cavalry] Grants another Mov+2. [Covert] Unit does not pay extra movement cost on any terrain.

Name: Dark Gallop
Description: Grants Mov+3.

Name: Override
Description: Use to attack and move through a line of adjacent foes. Sword/lance only. [Dragon] +20% damage. [Armored] 10% chance of breaking target. [Mystical] Deals extra damage=25% of Mag. [Qi Adept] 20% chance of breaking target.

Name: Holy Stance
Description: If a Corrupted attacks unit, deals 10% of damage taken back to foe.

Name: Holy Stance+
Description: If a Corrupted attacks unit, deals 30% of damage taken back to foe.

Name: Holy Stance++
Description: If a Corrupted attacks unit, deals 50% of damage taken back to foe.

Name: Unholy Stance
Description: If a non-Corrupted foe attacks unit, deals 50% of damage taken back to foe.

Name: Resonance
Description: When equipped with a tome, if unit’s HP is 2 or more, unit loses 1 HP at start of combat and deals +2 damage during combat.

Name: Resonance+
Description: When equipped with a tome, if unit’s HP is 2 or more, unit loses 1 HP at start of combat and deals +3 damage during combat.

Name: Favorite Food
Description: When unit eats a packed lunch, its engage meter is maxed out.

Name: Echo
Description: Use to attack with magic at 50% damage. Use a second time to launch another 50% attack. [Dragon] Range +1. [Mystical] +10% damage.

Name: Warp Ragnarok
Description: Use to warp up to 10 spaces and make a powerful magic attack. [Dragon] Attack range +1. [Cavalry] Warp distance +2. [Flying] Warp distance +5. [Mystical] +20% damage.

Name: Dark Warp
Description: Use to warp up to 5 spaces and make a powerful magic attack.

Name: Ragnarok Warp
Description: Use to make a powerful magic attack, then warp somewhere else on the map.

Name: Cleric
Description: Unit can equip staves up to level C.

Name: Cleric+
Description: Unit can equip staves up to level B.

Name: Cleric++
Description: Unit can equip staves up to level A.

Name: Silence Ward
Description: Grants immunity to silence.

Name: Healing Light
Description: When unit heals an ally with a staff, unit also recovers HP=50% of the amount healed.

Name: Augment
Description: Grants staff range +5 and area of effect +1. [Dragon] Additional staff range +1. [Qi Adept] +20% to HP healed by staves.

Name: Dark Augment
Description: Grants staff range +3 and area of effect +1.

Name: Great Sacrifice
Description: Use to restore full HP to all allies, even those not under the player’s control. After use, unit’s HP=1. [Dragon] Unit’s HP=30% current. [Armored] Grants Def+1 to all healed during their next combat. [Qi Adept] Also cures status.

Name: Hold Out
Description: If unit had 30% HP or more at start of combat, unit always survives combat with at least 1 HP.

Name: Hold Out+
Description: If unit had 20% HP or more at start of combat, unit always survives combat with at least 1 HP.

Name: Hold Out++
Description: If unit had 10% HP or more at start of combat, unit always survives combat with at least 1 HP.

Name: Hold Out+++
Description: If unit had 2 HP or more at start of combat, unit always survives combat with at least 1 HP.

Name: Advance
Description: Use to move 1 space toward a foe that is 2 spaces away and attack.

Name: Rise Above
Description: Grants Lvl+5. [Dragon] Additional Lvl+1. [Cavalry] Mov+1. [Armored] Max HP+5.

Name: Sink Below
Description: Grants Lvl+3.

Name: Blazing Lion
Description: Use to attack adjacent foe and an area 3 spaces wide. Target area and the 2 rows beyond it are set on fire. Sword only. [Dragon] Expands attack area. [Mystical] Expands flame area.

Name: Arms Shield
Description: When unit has weapon advantage, unit takes 3 less damage.

Name: Arms Shield+
Description: When unit has weapon advantage, unit takes 5 less damage.

Name: Arms Shield++
Description: When unit has weapon advantage, unit takes 7 less damage.

Name: Vantage
Description: If unit’s HP is 25% or less and foe initiates combat, unit can counter before foe’s first attack.

Name: Vantage+
Description: If unit’s HP is 50% or less and foe initiates combat, unit can counter before foe’s first attack.

Name: Vantage++
Description: If unit’s HP is 75% or less and foe initiates combat, unit can counter before foe’s first attack.

Name: Adaptable
Description: If foe initiates combat, unit counters with the best weapon available (in terms of range, weapon advantage, effective bonus, etc.). [Dragon] Hit+30 during combat. [Backup] Crit+10 during combat. [Covert] Avo+20 during combat. [Armored] Def+5 during combat. [Flying] Res+5 during combat.

Name: Quadruple Hit
Description: Use to attack once each with sword, lance, axe, and bow. [Dragon] +20% damage. [Covert] Foes may drop 1,000G. Trigger %=Lck. [Qi Adept] Breaks foe.

Name: Dual Strike
Description: Unit participates in chain attacks as if it were a backup unit.

Name: Dual Assist
Description: If unit is able to chain attack, unit will do so when allies attack foes unit could reach by moving. Trigger %=35.

Name: Dual Assist+
Description: If unit is able to chain attack, unit will do so when allies attack foes unit could reach by moving. Trigger %=70.

Name: Dual Support
Description: Grants a bonus to Avo that increases with unit’s support level with adjacent allies. (Max +90) [+5 Avoid for each support level. None = 1, C = 2, B = 3, A = 4, S = 6.]

Name: Bonded Shield
Description: Use to prevent first attacks on adjacent allies until your next turn. Trigger %=80. [Dragon] +10% to trigger rate. [Cavalry] Trigger %=100 for cavalry allies. [Armored] Trigger %=100 for armored allies. [Flying] Trigger %=100 for flying allies. [Qi Adept] Trigger %=100.

Name: All for One
Description: Use to make a sword attack against an adjacent foe. All allies within 2 spaces chain attack. [Dragon] Ally chain attacks are guaranteed to hit. [Backup] Range +1.

Name: Alacrity
Description: If unit initiates combat with a Spd advantage of 9 or more, unit’s follow-up (if possible) occurs before foe can counterattack.

Name: Alacrity+
Description: If unit initiates combat with a Spd advantage of 7 or more, unit’s follow-up (if possible) occurs before foe can counterattack.

Name: Alacrity++
Description: If unit initiates combat with a Spd advantage of 5 or more, unit’s follow-up (if possible) occurs before foe can counterattack.

Name: Speedtaker
Description: Grants a stacking Spd+2 each time unit initiates combat and defeats a foe. Bonus lasts for the rest of the battle. (Max +10)

Name: Call Doubles
Description: Creates four illusory doubles that can make chain attacks with unit. [Dragon] +1 double created. [Flying] Doubles have +10 Avo

Name: Astra Storm
Description: Use to launch 5 bow attacks at 30% damage, up to range 10. [Dragon] Range +5. [Covert] Range +10. [Qi Adept] Breaks the target.

Name: Demolish
Description: Break destructible terrain in a single blow when using Destroy.

Name: Reposition
Description: Use to move an adjacent ally to the opposite side of unit.

Name: Wrath
Description: At start of combat, for each HP the unit has lost, grants Crit+1 during combat. (Max +30)

Name: Resolve
Description: If unit’s HP is 75% or less after combat, grants Def/Res+5 as long as unit’s HP stays below 75%.

Name: Resolve+
Description: If unit’s HP is 75% or less after combat, grants Def/Res+7 as long as unit’s HP stays below 75%.

Name: Laguz Friend
Description: Unit takes 50% less damage, but sets unit’s Avo to 0. [Dragon] Extra -10% to damage.

Name: Great Aether
Description: Use to grant Def/Res+5, but unit can’t counter for 1 turn. Next turn, attack a 2-space area, heal HP=30% of damage dealt. Sword/axe only. [Dragon] +1 damage per hit taken. [Armored] Grants an extra Def+5. [Flying] Grants an extra Res+5.

Name: Divine Pulse
Description: May turn a missed attack into a hit. Trigger %=30. Chance increases with high Lck. [+1% for every 1 Luck.]

Name: Divine Pulse+
Description: May turn a missed attack into a hit. Trigger %=50. Chance increases with high Lck. [+1% for every 1 Luck.]

Name: Mentorship
Description: Grants 1.2× EXP modifier to unit and adjacent allies.

Name: Lost & Found
Description: If unit finishes an action or waits next to an ally, may find an item and increase support with that ally. Trigger %=Lck.

Name: Instruct
Description: Use to grant allies within 2 spaces a stat bonus based on user’s type. Bonus lasts for 1 turn. [Dragon] All seven basic stats +3. [Backup] Str+4. [Cavalry] Dex+10. [Covert] Spd+5. [Armored] Def+5. [Flying] Res+5. [Mystical] Mag+4. [Qi Adept] Lck+10.

Name: Goddess Dance
Description: Use to grant another action to all adjacent allies. [Dragon] Grants +3 to all targets’ basic stats for 1 turn. [Backup] Grants Str+4 to targets for 1 turn. [Cavalry] Grants Dex+10 to targets for 1 turn. [Covert] Grants Spd+5 to targets for 1 turn. [Armored] Grants Def+5 to targets for 1 turn. [Flying] Grants Res+5 to targets for 1 turn. [Mystical] Grants Mag+4 to targets for 1 turn. [Qi Adept] Grants Lck+10 to targets for 1 turn.

Name: Diabolical Dance
Description: Use to grant another action to allies within 2 spaces.

Name: Dragon Vein
Description: Use to add a special effect to certain spaces. [Dragon] Choose any Vein effect. [Backup] Creates stone pillars that increase Def/Res. [Cavalry] Creates water that decreases Avo. [Covert] Creates fog that increases Avo. [Armored] Creates vines that grant immunity to break. [Flying] Creates healing glow that restores HP. [Mystical] Creates flames that inflict damage. [Qi Adept] Creates ice pillars that hinder movement.

Name: Draconic Hex
Description: If unit initiates combat, inflicts -4 to all of foe’s basic stats after combat. (Penalties shrink by 1 each turn.)

Name: Pair Up
Description: Prevents damage from foes’ chain attacks against unit.

Name: Quality Time
Description: After unit acts or waits, restores 5 HP to adjacent allies and slightly increases support with them.

Name: Quality Time+
Description: After unit acts or waits, restores 10 HP to adjacent allies and slightly increases support with them.

Name: Dreadful Aura
Description: If unit initiates combat, target foe and all foes within 1 space of it cannot move for 1 turn after combat. [Covert] Also Avo-20 on target.

Name: Torrential Roar
Description: Use to attack 3 spaces in a line, turning those spaces into water terrain. [Dragon] Range +1

Name: Sacred Twins
Description: While engaged with Eirika, changes Lunar Brace to Eclipse Brace and Gentility to Blue Skies for all allies.

Name: Night and Day
Description: Use to switch Emblems and swap between Lunar Brace/Gentility and Solar Brace/Bravery for all allies.

Name: Lunar Brace
Description: If unit initiates combat with a physical attack, deals extra damage=20% of foe’s Def.

Name: Solar Brace
Description: If unit initiates combat, unit recovers HP=30% of damage dealt.
Obtain: Lunar Brace when swapped to Ephraim

Name: Eclipse Brace
Description: If unit initiates combat, unit deals extra damage=20% of foe’s Def with physical attacks and recovers HP=30% of damage dealt.

Name: Lunar Brace+
Description: If unit initiates combat with a physical attack, deals extra damage=30% of foe’s Def.

Name: Solar Brace+
Description: If unit initiates combat, unit recovers HP=50% of damage dealt.
Obtain: Lunar Brace+ when swapped to Ephraim

Name: Eclipse Brace+
Description: If unit initiates combat, unit deals extra damage=30% of foe’s Def with physical attacks and recovers HP=50% of damage dealt.

Name: Gentility
Description: Unit takes 3 less damage.

Name: Bravery
Description: Unit deals +3 damage.

Name: Blue Skies
Description: Unit takes 3 less damage and deals +3 damage.

Name: Gentility+
Description: Unit takes 5 less damage.

Name: Bravery+
Description: Unit deals +5 damage.

Name: Blue Skies+
Description: Unit takes 5 less damage and deals +5 damage.

Name: Twin Strike
Description: Use to make a sword attack followed by a lance attack from Ephraim on adjacent foe. Effective: Corrupted. [Dragon] +20% damage. [Cavalry] Ephraim deals +50% damage.

Name: Holy Aura
Description: Unit is Effective: Fell Dragon. Allies within 2 spaces with Effective: Dragon gain Effective: Fell Dragon. [Might multiplier of 2.]

Name: Holy Shield
Description: Neutralizes Effective against this unit.

Name: Bond Forger
Description: Grants Hit/Avo+20 to unit and allies within 2 spaces that are synced or engaged with an Emblem.

Name: Bond Forger+
Description: Grants Hit/Avo+30 to unit and allies within 2 spaces that are synced or engaged with an Emblem.

Name: Boon of Elyos
Description: If unit initiates combat, grants bonus to Crit and Ddg equal to 2× the number of allies who have acted this turn.

Name: Attuned
Description: If unit initiates combat and defeats foe, grants engage partner +4 to all seven basic stats while engaged. [Dragon] Extra +1 to all stats. [Backup] Extra +2 to Str. [Cavalry] Extra +2 to Dex. [Covert] Extra +2 to Spd. [Armored] Extra +2 to Def. [Flying] Extra +2 to Res. [Mystical] Extra +2 to Mag. [Qi Adept] Extra +2 to Lck.

Name: Dragon Blast
Description: Use to make two attacks against an adjacent foe with a sword and powerful magic beam. [Dragon] +20% damage. [Backup] Adds 20% of Str to sword attack. [Mystical] Adds 20% of Mag to beam attack. [Qi Adept] Breaks foe.

Name: Bond Blast
Description: Use to make a sword attack from the unit and engage partner followed by a magic beam attack against an adjacent foe. [Dragon] +20% damage. [Backup] +20% of Str to sword. [Mystical] +20% of Mag to beam. [Qi Adept] Breaks foe.
Obtain: Dragon Blast when Alear and engage partner are adjacent
